semantic_fidelity.reason: All six concepts, six directed historical relations and four source verbs are visibly preserved. Auth read and Worker write use distinct paths and distinct Postgres arrivals. The two source-unlabeled relations remain unlabeled, with no invented protocol. No extra apparent relation or split-view omission.

arrow_traceability.reason: Six source stems trace independently to six downward arrowheads. Eight ordinary bends have no touching, crossing, bridge, shared run or route junction. API fan-out and Postgres fan-in occur at separate node ports, not fake branches. All four edge-label owners are clear.

layout_fit.reason: Manifest independently measures 79x49 outer pane / 77x47 app interior. Actual ANSI grids are 77 columns by 47 rows; startup token is viewport: 77x47 zoom: 1.00 natural. All graph content lies within columns 23-54, rows 7-42; controls end at row 46. No clipping, occlusion, pan or zoom required.

conceptual_grouping_color.reason: Visible aqua shades relate API gateway/Auth, pink shades relate Job queue/Worker pool; CLI is gold and Postgres green. Related roles are near each other with top-down semantic pipeline order, not arbitrary depth-color cycling. All canvas/box fills are uniform #282828 and no background dot field is visible.

border_integrity.reason: All six normal perimeters (140 cells total) have complete sides/corners and one consistent per-node foreground. All six selected perimeters (another 140 cells) are complete, bold RGB 216,166,87. Coverage 6/6 in one simultaneous all-selected capture; no separately rendered handle states are shown or claimed.

workflow_evidence.reason: Frozen candidate, executable, rubric, dataset, source, expected, spec and capture digests match. Separate DeepSeek generator and Sol judge identities, blind-first record, one attempt, exact viewer commands, hash-pinned harness check command, combined check stdout/stderr and exit 0, dimensions, normal/selected/motion captures and pane cleanup records are present. Probe closes are recorded in generation.json; capture-pane closure is harness-confirmed. The stale Astra phrase in rubric prose is overridden by required_reviewer_model, schema and stage-B contract, all naming Sol.

animation.reason: Animation is source-required. Six routes each have one unobstructive dot in all five 200ms samples; four longer routes show source-to-target progression. The short CLI-to-API and queue-to-Worker routes show only two interior positions, alternating 12/13 and 28/29 respectively. Geometry and positive spec flow make directed cyclic wrapping plausible but cannot distinguish it from back-and-forth motion in the rendered samples. Thus direction for two required routes remains unestablished; no known border-dot, corner-dot, missing-dot or duplicate-dot failure is asserted.

findings.description: Insufficient direction evidence, not a proven reversed-flow defect: at 0/200/400/600/800ms e1 alternates (37,12)/(37,13) and e4 alternates (24,28)/(24,29). Their four-cell external routes have a source stem and destination arrowhead around only two observed dot positions. The apparent resets can be forward cyclic wrap or reversal; source-to-target direction cannot be independently established for these two requested animated routes from the frozen captures. All five frames have one dot per route and no observed corner, border, arrowhead or label collision.

blockers: P-MOTION-01: two-position sampled motion on e1/e4 cannot establish directed animation. Additional disambiguating actual-render evidence is required in a later sample, not produced by this judge. This is not proof that the renderer lacks directed animation.
